criteria.rationale: Done specs only gain warnings: measured with the final resolver, lint-spec --all passes in pose-dist (14 warnings) and Harne8 (28 warnings), with no error. Five CLI fixtures that cited test:TestFixture in a Git tree without it now declare the test.
POSE.md, the pt-BR manual and both scaffold copies state what a test: ref may name and when an unresolved one fails; the embedded dist and locale parity tests hold the four together.

The catalog is built once per process from git ls-files, read-bounded per file, and skipped entirely without Git, so lint-spec --all costs one listing per repository. Full native run at the sealed head with the candidate CLI built from it: every step passes, including trace-test-refs-integration.

One catalog file, the rule in lint-spec and in the close gate, tests, one matrix check, manuals and the spawned disposition; the fixture fix and a gofmt-only change ride along. Reviewed in the same session that implemented it, with no separate reviewer execution: declared, not independent.

The catalog only lists and reads tracked files under the repository, never follows symlinks (Lstat, regular files only), bounds each read at 2 MiB and runs git with a timeout; nothing from a spec is executed.
